newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Tuesday December 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Tuesday December 31.

text.p: Following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.

*Italian cabinet approves budget measures for 4.3 trillion lire, including incentive to car owners to scrap vehicles more than 10 years old for a new car at a discount. Other measures include help for other industrial sectors, lower value-added tax on certain foodstuffs but higher VAT on some medicines.(All)
*Snow and ice continue up and down Italy, disrupting road, rail and air traffic and killing three people.(All)
*Milan bourse has risen 12 percent in 1996, with record capitalisation, higher volumes but with reduced turnover on shares and fewer stocks quoted. (All)
*Municipalities studying possibility of issuing bonds on Germany's debt market.(Il Sole)
*Treasury is considering putting one director on board of state telecoms holding Stet. (Il Sole)
*Authorities can sell properties to tenants "at interesting prices", Labour Minister Tiziano Treu says. (Corriere).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
